📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • In a recent development, since the beginning of the week, the James Bond frenzy has shown no signs of stopping.
  • The exception in thie great debate is Léa Seydoux.
  • Léa Seydoux and Daniel Craig pose as they arrive on the set of No Time To Die on September 09, 2019 in Matera, Italy.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, since the beginning of the week, the James Bond frenzy has shown no signs of stopping. On November 16, new Bond owners Amazon MGM Studios finally revealed the name of the actor who will succeed Daniel Craig as 007: Robert Pattinson. After years of speculation and months of intense rumors, the next James Bond now has a new face. Now, the next question on everyone’s mind: Who will be the next Bond girl?

The exception in thie great debate is Léa Seydoux. The actor, who seems to be everywhere this year, played Madeleine Swann in Craig's final Bond films, Spectre (2015) and No Time to Die (2021). Her magnetic performance made Madeleine an unforgettable Bond girl, especially since her character plays a decisive role in the arc of Craig’s character: at the end of No Time to Die, the famous spy sacrifices himself to save her and their daughter, Mathilde. For the first time since its creation in 1953 by British author Ian Fleming, the secret agent in Her Majesty’s service was gone.

Léa Seydoux and Daniel Craig pose as they arrive on the set of No Time To Die on September 09, 2019 in Matera, Italy.

In a recent interview on Vogue's The Run-Through podcast, Seydoux was candid about how little interest she had in her successor. “I don’t really care,” she mentioned with a laugh. “I don’t really care, guys. How can you?”.

According to recent reports, when pressed on who Pattinson's female lead might be, Seydoux expressed mixed feelings about the British spy's latest iteration. With the purchase of the Bond IP by Amazon, “It became American," Seydoux remarked. “But I’m sure the movie will be great because it’s directed by Denis Villeneuve, who’s a very talented director. I’m sure he will do something great.”.

Sources indicate that the online megamart took control of the storied franchise in 2023, after which Amazon founder Jeff Bezos controversially sought feedback on the title character's casting via X. The announcement of Villeneuve as the next film's director brought things back from the brink.

Bezos, who confirmed that he was “very involved” in the film's casting process, also seems to give Seydoux pause. In an interview with Variety, she admitted “was a bit sad when I heard that it was sold (…) but now that it’s Denis, I was like, Oh, at least it’s him, so it will be cinema.”.

In a recent development, denis Villeneuve, who directed Seydoux in Dune: Part Two, will release the final installment of this epic science-fiction trilogy will be on December 16. After that, he'll be free to focus on his next major project: reviving the world’s most famous secret agent. It remains to be seen who he will choose to star opposite Robert Pattinson as his female companion—but we know that despite her fondness for the director, Seydoux will not return: Just last month, the French actress told People “I really loved being on this franchise, but now it’s ... done.”.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Deborah Ann Woll, who plays Faye in the upcoming God of War Laufey, is coming back to play the character again in Prime Video's God of War show. Industry observers note that at the heart of the alleged counterfeiting operation is a practice known as “proxying.” Sometimes players use what are known as “proxy cards,” or stand-ins for cards they don’t own or don’t want to damage by using in play. It’s a commonly accepted, sometimes even celebrated practice, as proxies can also feature cool, custom-made art. But proxies are not meant to look like real Magic cards, and that’s the crux of the issue with PrintMTG’s practice of printing cards that it calls proxies but that are designed to be indistinguishable from the real thing. “They intend that the people who encounter their product after the sale, including opponents, judges, retailers, and later purchasers, will mistake it for Wizardsâ genuine product,” Wizards writes in its suit.

According to Aftermath, Wizards’ lawsuit claims PrintMTG Enterprises operates out of a number of differently named websites, some of which have allegedly been obtained via domain hijacking. One website, KrakenOpus.com, was a luxury publishing operation whose website has now been turned into an independent MTG news site with links that direct owners to a proxy printing website, proxyking.biz, which is at the moment down. The suit alleges that the business behind PrintMTG doesn’t just make counterfeit MTG cards, but fake PokÃ©mon cards and Lego minifigs as well.

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (863 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Gamespot

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Grand Theft Auto VI is a visual and audial treat, and is easily one of the most technically impressive games on the current generation of consoles.
  • Recent findings suggest that grand Theft Auto VI is a visual and audial treat, and is easily one of the most technically impressive games on the current generation of consoles.
  • That's due to an HDR calibration tool that isn't exactly working in the way that you expect it.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Grand Theft Auto VI is a visual and audial treat, and is easily one of the most technically impressive games on the current generation of consoles. But it isn't without concerns, especially if you're trying to experience the sights and sounds of Vice City with all the moody contrast and bright highlights that HDR offers. That's due to an HDR calibration tool that isn't exactly working in the way that you expect it. Like many other games, GTA VI doesn't use the system-level HDR settings on either the PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X|S. Instead it features its own calibration tool, which lets you adjust the maximum brightness, black levels, and paper white values that work best on your display. While the tool makes calibration seem straightforward, there's an issue with it that makes it very unreliable. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d3UaVoP6dPg Specifically, the maximum brightness and paper white point values seem to be linked in a way that is both unclear and incorrect. Normally you would set these values individually, with maximum brightness set according to the value your display supports and the paper white value that looks best to you. GTA VI instead changes the maximum peak brightness value it is storing as you change the paper white point. For example, if you set a maximum peak brightness at 1000 nits (a typical value) but then reduce the paper white point (given how how its default is), the peak brightness value reduces as well, with no indication to you that it's happening. HDR enthusiasts and handy calibration assistors HDTVTest and GamingTech have both confirmed the issue, and provided some rough workarounds until Rockstar (hopefully) releases a fix. The idea is setting the maximum brightness value higher than your display supports, but in line with what the game is expecting based on the paper white point value to choose. It's confusing, but GamingTech has drawn up a table that might help depending on your display's specifications. HDTVTest's approach is similar but with different recommended values for both the ideal paper white point and black level values, so you'll need to do some experimenting on your end to find what suits your setup best. Rockstar has released the first patch for GTA VI, but it mostly addresses some widespread bugs that players have been encountering since launch. HDR issues were also common at launch with Red Dead Redemption 2 but eventually were fixed sometime after, but if you're like 45 million other people and planning to explore Leonida today, then hopefully these tweaks let you get it looking its finest.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Black Friday sales officially start Friday, November 28, and run through Cyber Monday, November 30, 2026, and Lifehacker is sharing the best sales based on product reviews and comparisons before it's over.

Sales are accurate at the time of publication, but prices and inventory are always subject to change.

Industry observers note that not every Black Friday or Cyber Monday deal is as sweet as it seems. With electronics and tech in particular, you could be buying last year's model that has actually been on sale since the summer—and was maybe a better price a few months ago. Here’s how to avoid impulse buying a misleading Black Friday “deal” and make sure you’re getting the best bang for your buck.

Sources indicate that when you see products like food, clothes, or home goods with a significant "Black Friday" or "Cyber Monday" tag slapped on them, it's probably safe to take advantage of that deal. Chances are it's the same exact product you'd find on other days of the year. The same can’t be remarked for a TV, laptop, and other tech deals, where the product itself is constantly being upgraded.

It has been revealed that because tech is always evolving, and retailers want to move inventory before upcoming models come out, electronics are especially susceptible to a practice known as "price anchoring." That's when retailers mark up prices in the weeks leading up to Black Friday, before "slashing" those prices back down, giving the appearance of a deal that isn't really a deal at all. Still, when you see that marked-up number, aka the "price anchor," you might get tricked into thinking you're saving money when you're not. There's also the false sense of urgency that gets created. It's second nature to assume that anything labeled "deal" won’t last long—even when this so-called deal price has actually been going on since the summer.

Price anchoring isn't even unique to Black Friday. The nonprofit Consumers’ Checkbook tracked prices at 25 major retailers over 33 weeks in 2022 and found that more than half the items tracked were offered at false discounts every week or almost every week. Less common, but also worth noting, is a known practice of "derivative" or retailer-exclusive models produced specifically for the holiday shopping season. These versions often feature cheaper components, fewer features, or lower specifications than their regular counterparts. A 55-inch TV from a reputable brand might look identical to the year-round model, but it could have a lower refresh rate, inferior panel technology, or fewer HDMI ports.

In the same vein, that "amazing deal" on a laptop might come with last year's processor, or a smartphone that's about to be replaced. The concern isn't that the tech is an older model, but again, it's that it probably has been at this low a price, or lower, since the summer. Alternatively, some deeply discounted electronics are refurbished units or open-box returns that have been repackaged. Again, while this isn't necessarily a bad thing, impulse buyers may not fully realize what they're buying.

It has been revealed that the key phrasing here is impulse buying. Events like Black Friday are psychologically engineered to trigger impulse purchases. Limited-time offers, countdown clocks, and "while supplies last" warnings create artificial urgency. When you're caught up in the moment, it's easy to convince yourself you need a latest tablet, smartwatch, or gaming console, even if you hadn't considered buying one before.

To avoid a low-key scam, do your research. The easiest way to tell that you’re getting the correct product is by checking the model or serial number. And with online shopping, finding and double-checking those numbers is quick and easy. In addition, don't just compare prices—compare specs. Look at processor speeds, RAM, storage capacity, screen resolution, refresh rates, and connectivity options. A $300 laptop isn't a deal if a slightly more expensive model offers significantly better performance that will last longer.

If you do see a deal that catches your eye, it could pay to wait. Cyber Monday, post-Christmas sales, and even January clearances often feature electronics deals that rival or beat Black Friday prices, all without the famous chaos and pressure. Then again, you risk more “out-of-stock” results if you wait, so the risk is up to you, depending on the popularity of the item you’re eyeing (and how badly you want it).

The bottom line: Don’t fall victim to a falsely advertised lower-quality product, and do a little research to find actually good deals ahead of time.

Industry observers note that yes, Amazon has Black Friday sales, and we vet our deals to make sure they’re the best ones. You can also refer to guides like our live blog that have already done all of the vetting for you. And if you have an Amazon Prime membership, make the most of it.

Nowadays, both large retailers and small businesses compete for Black Friday shoppers, so you can expect practically every store to run sales through Monday, November 30, 2026. The “best” sales depend on your needs, but in general, the biggest discounts tend to come from larger retailers who can afford lower prices: think places like Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy, and Home Depot. You can find all the best sales from major retailers on our Black Friday coverage.

Industry observers note that yes. Walmart, Best Buy, Target, and Home Depot will all have in-store deals, some of which you might not find online, so if you're able to take a trip to your local retailer, keep your eyes open for different deals.

In a recent development, yes, Apple participates in Black Friday, though you may want to compare their sales with other retailers like Best Buy and Walmart. So far, the best Black Friday sale on an Apple product is the M5 MacBook Air on sale for $200 off, the lowest price since the price hike this summer.

Sources indicate that black Friday sales officially begin Friday, November 27, 2026, and run throughout “Cyber Week,” the five-day period that runs from Thanksgiving through Cyber Monday,  November 30, 2026. But Black Friday and Cyber Monday dates have expanded as retailers compete for customers. You can get the same Black Friday sales early, and we expect sales to wind down by December 2, 2026.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Derek Hough and wife Hayley Erbert are pulling back the curtain on their relationship — and her near fatal brain bleed — in the upcoming documentary The Symphony of Dance.

The film followed the couple on the final leg of their tour in 2023, when Erbert, 32, experienced a medical emergency.

“At the very beginning of the opening number, there’s a move where she kind of comes down to my arms, I wrap her up and she twists really fast. We both move our head[s] forward and we hit heads very hard. We both kind of [were] looking at each other like, ‘Are you OK?’” Hough, 41, recalled.

Erbert added, “I probably had five dances left, and all of a sudden, I get this excruciating headache, just on the right side. I didn’t know exactly what to do in that moment except for [think], ‘OK, just go back out on stage and just keep pushing through. You’re almost done with the show.’ Derek indicates I didn’t skip a beat, I didn’t miss a step. I actually don’t remember any of it. And then I came off stage and collapsed.”.

Hough recalled Erbert “dying” on the ground, having seizures. She eventually underwent an emergency craniectomy for a hematoma. Weeks later, Erbert had a second surgery to replace a large portion of her skull that was removed in the initial procedure.

Erbert ultimately returned to the stage just months later. The pair went on to welcome their daughter, Everley, in 2025. The film is dedicated to their daughter.

Hough recalled not being able to keep his eyes off of Erbert when he first watched her perform in a dance studio, but he claimed they “didn’t click straight away.”.

Erbert went on to note that she felt “intimidated” by Hough considering how well-known he is in the dancing community.

Industry observers note that “We took it really slow to get to where we are and I’m really appreciative that we did because we worked through so many things in life that it made us as strong as we are today,” she explained. “And that’s why I think we can go through these crazy roller-coaster of emotions like we have in just the past six months of marriage.”.

Hough recalled having neighbors who “weren’t great,” sharing that “they pretty much terrorized” his family “in a lot of ways.”.

In a recent development, in a separate scene, Erbert reflected on how the male dancer’s biggest priority is “don’t ever drop your partner.” She added, “So he truly felt that he was the reason why this happened. He tortured himself for weeks.”.

While navigating the aftermath of her surgery, Erbert shared that she has questioned why it happened to her.

Recent findings suggest that “One was just like, ‘I’m in the medical field and you should absolutely not be [returning] if this was a real surgery.’ And I was like, ‘You think I faked a surgery? What the heck?’” she remarked. “Interesting.”.

Industry observers note that how was life under Electronic Arts for BioWare? Not great, according to many former developers. But perhaps no quote has put the seemingly impossible situation the RPG powerhouse was put in more than one recently shared by Dragon Age executive producer Mark Darrah.

The veteran developer stated EA leadership never came in and made the bad decisions directly. Instead, they set broader objectives and laid out a list of options for meeting them that ranged from bad to worse. One famous example was the need to ship a game rapidly because Star Wars: The Old Republic, the studio’s ambitious MMORPG, was falling behind. The Dragon Age team rushed into the breach and ended up delivering Dragon Age 2Â in under two years. The result was one of BioWare’s most poorly received RPGs.

We chose the least terrible of the options.'”.

Instead of being a one-off, Dragon Age 2 proved a harbinger of worse troubles to come. While Mass Effect 3 and Dragon Age: Inquisition both blew audiences away, things eventually unraveled with a string of troubled development cycles on games including Mass Effect: Andromeda,Â Anthem and, most recently, Dragon Age: The Veilguard. Following its sale to Saudi Arabia over the summer, EA elected to cancel the upcoming Mass Effect: Universe and close the studio for good.

In a recent development, “I think it caught a lot of people by surprise because it was seen as sort of ‘well, they would never close BioWare,'” Darrah noted. “But I think that every time a major studioâs closed, I think thatâs peopleâs reaction, is ‘they would never close X.'”.

#188802. Breaking: The Method-Dressing Madness Behind Mckenna Grace’s ‘Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’ Press Tour Looks

Breaking: The Method-Dressing Madness Behind Mckenna Grace’s ‘Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’ Press Tour Looks

📅 21 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 14 min read (2832 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Vanityfair

⏱️ ~14 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • It has been revealed that before the Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping press tour began, Mckenna Grace knew she wanted to be method dressed for her appearances.
  • Recent findings suggest that with the newly introduced Hunger Games film, it’s Grace’s turn to adopt the trend.
  • In a wide-ranging conversation, Dickson breaks down all the looks that set the Hunger Games fans’ hearts aflame, from Rue’s blue dress to Katniss’ Mockingjay gown, and all the threads that came together for Grace’s most memorable press appearances yet.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It has been revealed that before the Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping press tour began, Mckenna Grace knew she wanted to be method dressed for her appearances. Made a household term by Law Roach and Zendaya, method dressing is when actors wear looks that pay homage to the film or show they’re promoting: See Zendaya’s on-theme looks across red carpets for Dune, Spiderman, and The Odyssey for a slew of examples.

Recent findings suggest that with the newly introduced Hunger Games film, it’s Grace’s turn to adopt the trend. A super fan of the Suzanne Collins book series and their film adaptations, Grace—who plays District 12 tribute Maysilee Donner—took a hand in the styling for her press run, weaving easter eggs into every look. Her stylist, Molly Dickson, was up for the challenge of translating Grace’s deep-cut references into custom and archival looks from Monique Lhuillier, Gucci, Celine and more.

In a wide-ranging conversation, Dickson breaks down all the looks that set the Hunger Games fans’ hearts aflame, from Rue’s blue dress to Katniss’ Mockingjay gown, and all the threads that came together for Grace’s most memorable press appearances yet.

Vanity Fair: How did you get into styling?

In a recent development, molly Dickson: I went to college in Minnesota and my major was advertising. Two weeks before I graduated, I called my mom and said, "I'm not into this. I don't wanna do advertising." She said, "Well, what do you wanna do?" I told her, "I wanna do fashion. I wanna go to New York." She said, "No, absolutely not.".

Sources indicate that right after I graduated, I went to LA, this was 2009 during the recession, and no one was hiring. I got an internship at Marie Claire in New York, and enrolled back into college to get school credit to intern at Hearst. I worked at Marie Claire as a market assistant for almost two years, and then I left and assisted Leslie Fremar for seven years. That's when I fell in love with celebrity. Then ten years ago, I went off on my own.

What would you say are your aesthetic influences as a stylist?

Sources indicate that my personal style relates very similarly to Sadie Sink's style, very effortless. She always wants to be very comfortable and easy, never anything frilly or over the top. Just a simple, beautiful dress, and you let it speak for itself.

Recent findings suggest that mckenna is a big fan of the original film series, so it’s clear you’re pulling from there as influences when dressing her. Is it a collaborative process when coming to one of these referential looks?

Industry observers note that she's obviously a very huge fan of the franchise. We actually started having conversations about this tour in April, which is very early to start having conversations. I could just sense her excitement around it. She started sending me mood boards, and I actually looked back today at the mood board and it was, it was a lot of Katniss Everdeen. It had Joanna on it, and it was filled with these really strong female characters from the franchise.

According to recent reports, what she really wanted to hit was Katniss’ wedding gown look and the Mockingjay look with the wings. I was really stumped on how to pull that off without making it overly costumey.

Mckenna kept asking, "What's going on with those?" I knew the vision, but I didn't know how to execute it. I was working with Keke Palmer and the designer Michael Ngo. He was making some cool music costumes for Keke, and I asked, "Michael, could you make this silver piece?" 'Cause I really had no idea how to get it done.

He said, “I don't think I can do that. You know what? Just give me a day, let me play around with it." That night, he said, "I figured it out." We got the piece and I thought, "Okay, it needs to be a wedding dress under,” so I reached out to all the bridal houses. I wanted it to be vintage because it would tell a pretty story. Monique [Lhuillier] ended up sending a ton of wedding gowns, and the day before Mckenna came in for the fitting, I actually tried the wedding dresses on myself with the silver piece.

I sent Mckenna five dresses, and the one that she ended up wearing, she said, "That's it. I don't even need to try anything else. That's the one I'm gonna wear." Then, it was a matter of finding the right event to wear it to because it’s pretty nice, very dramatic.

She was in Paris for the Miu Miu show, and I brought it there because she had the Hunger Games Museum event. It was a whole conversation with her team, like, "Is it the right moment? Is it too much for this event?" Her PR stated, "No, this is the perfect moment. It's the best way to kick off the tour." The response with the Hunger Games fans—I have never seen anything like it before, ever.

What was the experience of having her be such a big part of the styling process?

It makes my job so fun because she is so passionate about it and she loves Hunger Games so much, even just finding subtle nods back to the movie. She would say, "I wanna do a ladybug look." Thom Browne did that amazing ladybug dress, I thought, "That's so cool, but it's not really her personal aesthetic." So it’s finding ways to keep it still true to her personal style while maintaining the nods to the film.

Recent findings suggest that the way you seem to understand Mckenna feels something similar to the connection between Katniss and Cinna in The Hunger Games. When pulling looks for her, what comes into play? How do you make her come through and not be lost in the lore of the stories or the dress?

Mckenna had remarked that she maybe wanted to do a red or a dark pink feather look because in the books [Maysilee] gets attacked by the red birds which are like flamingos. I'm pulling in all these red feather dresses and on the runway, this one dress looked amazing. Mckenna said, “That's perfect for the flamingo reference.”.

But we put it on her and it was so substantial, and she's so petite so she was just getting swarmed. I said, “Let"s not force it.” The goal was for her to feel comfortable in the look rather than just getting each reference.

The public has been really excited about these looks. Are you thinking about the response to the looks when you’re putting them together?

There's been some conversations in a fitting, like, "Oh, the Hunger Games fans are gonna get this." They're gonna see the inspiration, they're gonna understand it.

But I wouldn't say we're choosing a look because ‘Oh, this is gonna go viral to the Hunger Games community.’ Mckenna is a super fan herself so if she's getting excited about the look, everyone else that's a fan of the franchise is gonna get excited about the look.

Mckenna Grace in Betsey Johnson.

Do you feel any pressure to top the last outfit after each premiere?

Yes. I think it was Paris because that wedding dress did get so much press. In that fitting, it felt like, "We gotta keep our game up high." It's been really fun for my team and market assistants because a lot of the girls that work with me are huge fans of the movie. They're not even seeing it as work. They're like, "Oh my God, this is so exciting. Look at this. This looks like this from the movie.".

Recent findings suggest that what was the inspiration to do method dressing for this press run? What do you think is the value?

Mckenna knew back in April, she said, "I wanna do method for this." I personally did not read the books. I'm a visual person, so I've seen all the movies. Lionsgate was able to let me go with the cast when they first saw the movie because my agent was like, "Molly needs to go to the movie to get inspired before this press tour. She can't do a method dressing press tour without seeing the movie.".

Even as the tour was going on, Mckenna kept sending me newly introduced references and quotes from the book and stuff like that.

It has been revealed that what made you take it to the next level? From paying homage to not only characters, but the actual actors from the films like Jennifer Lawrence at the 2011 Oscars to even dressing like set pieces from the film.

It has been revealed that that was all Mckenna's vision. On her first mood board, she had a lot of Jennifer Lawrence's red carpet moments because she's such a huge fan of Katniss and Jennifer Lawrence.

With the Rue reference, Mckenna thought that color was just very Hunger Games. It wasn't until she put the dress on, her mom mentioned, "Wait, this is Rue's dress." So that was just fate. I would love to take credit for that.

Why do you think that this styling has generated so much attention?

I think it’s when you do method dressing for such a massive franchise and you really are passionate about it. The thing is that Mckenna is so excited and passionate about this movie. She has noted, “I didn't think that I would love doing fittings so much. I used to hate doing fittings.”.

Mckenna Grace in Elisabetta Franchi.

Because every look is so intentionally tied back to Hunger Games and she's such a massive fan, it's literally like playing dress up with her. I think the fans see it, she's so relatable because she's a fan that all these fans think, "Wow, like, she's a fan and she got to do this." She’s the fangirl living out her dream, and the fans are excited for her that she finally gets to do this.

What do you think are the best kinds of projects to implement method dressing with/works best with? What does it work best with?

I think the massive movies that already have a fan base, like Barbie or Wednesday, Being able to pull inspiration from existing books or films makes it so much easier for a stylist rather than a movie that no one's seen before. There's no curiosity or momentum about it because you're starting from scratch, whereas Hunger Games, Barbie, Wednesday, there's already a level of expectation.

The looks for this press run have been a mix of archival, upcoming, and custom pieces. How do you make that choice? How notable is it for you to create an archive for Mckenna?

It kind of is a mix of what we’re able to source. Mckenna really wanted to pay homage to Joanna's character with that scene where she's like, "My stylist is always putting me in trees." She's like, "I wanna do a tree reference." And I'm like, "How in the world am I gonna find a fashion reference that's a tree that's not a costume?".

It has been revealed that I love the challenge of sourcing the market, and so do the girls on my team. I think it was 2011 Phoebe Philo where Celine did some tree references in the collection. But just because we find it online doesn't mean that we can get it. So then it's reaching out to every vintage dealer, every rental house, asking, "Do you guys have anything like this?" And they might have it, but they're like, "It's already gone, someone has it." I ended up actually finding the Celine tree dress on the RealReal, and I bought it. I love RealReal.

Recent findings suggest that what is your approach to dressing different clients? For instance, you mentioned Sadie Sink earlier, can you walk me through how that process differs from Mckenna?

According to recent reports, it's very different between each girl. I let them set the pace. If they wanna be involved, great. If they just wanna show up to the fitting and not even know what's gonna be there, I try to accommodate whatever direction they wanna go. I have one client that literally last week has sent me over 200 references of dresses that she wants, and another girl that's like, “I really don't care. Whatever you tell me to wear, I'll wear it.”.

It has been revealed that every girl is different, and what makes my job so interesting is that it's not the same. Everyone has very different styles. I think the most important part of a job as a stylist is to keep their style true to them and not just force my style onto them. Mckenna's way more girly, Sadie is a little bit more casual, it’s just taking their style and elevating it a little bit.

In a recent development, will you do any looks inspired by Mckenna’s character Maysilee? The looks have been mostly referential to things and people from past stories. Are there influences of Maysilee in the looks that fans haven't been able to pick up on because the film wasn’t out yet?

It has been revealed that in a couple days, she’ll be in Miami for press, and she's wearing a very Maysilee inspired, purple Miu Miu dress that has a white collar. When she wears it, everyone's gonna be like, "Oh, that's Maysilee." She really wanted to have flowers and necklaces because Maysilee is really into jewelry, so it’s very light and flowery.

Can you break down the outfit for the New York City premiere?

We are doing the Mockingjay dress, the one with the wings, and that was another thing that I was very stumped on. I'm like, "What designer's gonna make these wings?" I had this woman in LA who does wings, she's done Halloween costumes and music videos.

Mckenna Grace in Pamella Roland.

Sources indicate that in the first fitting, I pulled this navy Pamella Roland gown. The fabric is really, really cool. It's like a shimmery kind of organza. I thought, "That's the right color,” but I wanted it to be strapless. I went back to Pamella Roland and they were like, "We can make it in strapless." Mckenna was very keen on having some sort of embellishment to replicate Katniss because she had screen printing on the gown and it kind of looks like wings in a way.

Sources indicate that pamella then drew all these CADs with diamond wings on it, and then we got the wings made. We did the final fitting and I almost started to cry. Her mom's taking videos and it's epic. It's so exciting because the fans were doing polls on what she's gonna wear to the premiere.

It's full circle, we started with the wedding dress, Mckenna did the fire gown, and then we ended with the Mockingjay dress.

What was the hardest look to pull together?

Mckenna Grace in custom Cong Tri.

I think design-wise, it was the fire gown.

Getting the fire printed on the fabric was really hard. I had a while back done a custom Cong Tri gown for Cami Mendes for the Masters of the Universe tour. It was like a gold beaded gown, and I remember I really liked the fabrics that they used for it.

So when I was thinking of who could do this fire gown, I reached out to them first, and I'm like, "Can you guys do something that looks like a fire? Like, she's literally on fire." And they're like, "No. We don't think we can." And again, they were like, "Give us some time." They came back and stated, "We did all these testing on the fabric." I'm like, "Yeah, you did it. You did it.".

It has been revealed that what's really funny is we were at a fitting at Mckenna's house with the fire gown in a garment bag, and one of her friends stopped by. It was just a tip of the dress showing and her friend said, "Oh my God, you got a fire gown." Then I thought, "Okay, people are gonna get it.".

📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Lords of the Fallen 2 will now launch in April 2027, and we'll find out exactly when next month.
  • The news came via a short post on X from CI Games founder and CEO Marek Tyminski.
  • Recent findings suggest that that means the Soulslike sequel has slipped again.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Lords of the Fallen 2 will now launch in April 2027, and we'll find out exactly when next month.

The news came via a short post on X from CI Games founder and CEO Marek Tyminski. "Lords of the Fallen II: April 2027," he wrote. "Exact date in December.".

Recent findings suggest that that means the Soulslike sequel has slipped again. Back in June, CI Games pushed Lords of the Fallen 2 into a Q1 2027 release window, saying the extra time would let the team refine the game and keep it clear of "a highly competitive holiday period". That was a delay in itself, as when CI Games and Epic ended the game's PC exclusivity deal in May, it was still targeting a 2026 release.

It has been revealed that last month, CI Games secured a €28.6 million (around $32 million) loan to complete production and release Lords of the Fallen 2, as well as refinance its existing bank debt, according to a stock exchange filing. The loan matures on 31st August 2027, and, as reported at the time, CI Games will self-publish the game and expects to repay the loan through its sales.

Sources indicate that lords of the Fallen II: April 2027. Exact date in December. pic.twitter.com/yYaevDqaxe.

Lords of the Fallen 2 is coming to PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store.

Following its announcement in 2025 and a look at gameplay during that year's The Game Awards, Lords of the Fallen 2 - which is technically the series' third game if we don't ignore the fact it was rebooted - had been steadily marching towards an unspecified 2026 launch. On PC, the strategy was for it to be an Epic Games Store exclusive, but that's no longer happening after we learned CI Games - developer and sole owner of the IP - is now free from the multi-year exclusivity deal with Epic Games.

The sequel has also been at the centre of heated conversations following CI Games founder and CEO Marek Tyminski's comments regarding "political correctness" and "real player feedback". The studio also raised eyebrows recently by announcing more revealing armour sets for female characters in Lords of the Fallen 2, for instance, compared to its previous project.

Eurogamer gave the rebooted Lords of the Fallen two stars, calling it "a perfectly acceptable Soulslike that's often fun to play and offers the same satisfaction at overcoming adversity", but one let down by "Soulslike clichés and performance woes".

💡 Key Takeaways
  • CD Projekt made its Q3 2026 financial report today, and there's not a whole lot to see: The Witcher 3 remaster was a massive hit, work on Cyberpunk 2 and The Witcher 4 is ticking along, and everyone really liked Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2.
  • Perhaps understandably, a number of questions in the subsequent investors call put the focus on Grand Theft Auto 6.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

CD Projekt made its Q3 2026 financial report today, and there's not a whole lot to see: The Witcher 3 remaster was a massive hit, work on Cyberpunk 2 and The Witcher 4 is ticking along, and everyone really liked Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2.

Perhaps understandably, a number of questions in the subsequent investors call put the focus on Grand Theft Auto 6. While CD Projekt joint CEO Michał Nowakowski didn't go too deep on the topic, he did say that the upcoming Witcher 4 will be comparable to GTA 6 in at least one way.

It has been revealed that "Obviously, this is a call about us, not about Rockstar, but I do understand the connection here," Nowakowski remarked when asked if The Witcher 4 will represent a technological leap over its predecessor comparable to GTA 6. "Having said that, of course, I'm not going to make a deep dive and a full-blown review of GTA 5 versus GTA 6. But of course, we did look at the game. We did see the differences.

Sources indicate that "Do we believe there's going to be a comparable leap between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4? I think so, yes. I mean, it's been 11 years. We are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game. So yes, you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4.".

It has been revealed that well, sure. As Nowakowski said, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt was released 11 years ago, and it'll be two more years before The Witcher 4 comes out—assuming it's not delayed, which would make it a rarity among CD Projekt games. It will also be the same number of years between Witcher 3 and 4 as spanned GTA 5 and 6. In the world of technology, 13 years is a long time.

Hell, just the upgrade from the original Witcher 3 to the remastered version that dropped earlier this year is notable:.

At the same time, Nowakowski said that while the GTA 6 launch was tremendously successful, CD Projekt Red doesn't intend to merely mimic Rockstar's approach when The Witcher 4 is ready to go: "Our games are different and the require a certain different approach, and we just do certain things differently than they do.".

Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team.

He also stated that while the release of GTA 6 has had an impact on Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 sales on consoles, he doesn't expect it to have a "material impact" on the organization's Q4 finances for one obvious reason.

"You do have to remember that a lot of our players are also PC-based," Nowakowski said. "GTA has not debuted on PC. We have not seen any impact whatsoever on the PC sales on engagement." And, he added, "on the PS5 and Xbox, it's not like our sales came to zero.".

Nowakowsi also stated that GTA 6 hasn't changed CD Projekt's ambitions for The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2: If anything, it's "an inspiration in many ways for our developers." And he's not concerned about its success pushing up development budgets, because CD Projekt's games "are not budget-driven developments.".

"I'm not saying that we don't care about the budgets. We do, and I'm pretty sure [Rockstar] did as well," Nowakowski noted. "But you cannot make games like that having in mind, 'This is the fixed number of money I want to spend, and that's it. Otherwise, we're gone.'.

Sources indicate that "They are ambition-driven developments and money is important. The budgets are not indefinite. That's not what we're saying. But the philosophy is kind of like I mentioned. And honestly, that philosophy has not changed for us because of GTA 6's release. It has just always been like that.".

Nowakowski's positive take on GTA 6 isn't too far off that of Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzynski, who said yesterday that he's suffering from "GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression," although he promptly clarified that CD Projekt is "doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor." (And that he wasn't being serious about cancelling Cyberpunk 2.).

It has been revealed that seriously though i think we're doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor. GTA is impressive in a way all great art is, it expands what is possible, a captivating vision flawlessly executed.

The Witcher 4 is currently slated for launch sometime in 2028, while Cyberpunk 2 isn't expected out before 2030.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • “Cancer does change you,” Kate Middleton says, emotion clear in her voice.
  • According to Kensington Palace, which unveiled the film on Saturday, Heal is “a deeply personal fresh documentary from The Princess of Wales, exploring life beyond diagnosis and the many ways people find comfort, strength and hope in the face of serious illness.” It will air on the BBC in the UK on November 29, and in the US on NBCUniversal on November 30.
  • Heal follows Kate Middleton during her participation in one of the United Kingdom’s most demanding endurance events: The National Three Peaks Challenge, which she completed this summer.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

“Cancer does change you,” Kate Middleton says, emotion clear in her voice. “It changes your body, it changes you physically. But there’s a much, much deeper part to what a cancer diagnosis shifts in you.” These words come not at as an Instagram post or at a public event. Instead, they're the voice-over in a previously unannounced documentary about the Princess of Wales and her life since she disclosed a diagnosis of cancer in 2024.

According to Kensington Palace, which unveiled the film on Saturday, Heal is “a deeply personal fresh documentary from The Princess of Wales, exploring life beyond diagnosis and the many ways people find comfort, strength and hope in the face of serious illness.” It will air on the BBC in the UK on November 29, and in the US on NBCUniversal on November 30.

Heal follows Kate Middleton during her participation in one of the United Kingdom’s most demanding endurance events: The National Three Peaks Challenge, which she completed this summer. In less than 24 hours, the princess climbed the three highest mountains in Scotland, England, and Wales: Ben Nevis (4,413 feet), Scafell Pike (3,209 feet), and Yr Wyddfa–Snowdon (3,559 feet). The undertaking wasn't just a personal effort, as it was also in support of the Royal Marsden Cancer Charity, an organization that supports people living with cancer before, during, and after the disease.

The documentary will also support that organization, Kensington Palace notes, saying “All funds received through the documentary's distribution have been directed to The Royal Marsden Cancer Charity to help people living with and beyond cancer.” The Royal Marsden Hospital, at which Middleton received treatment, is also referenced in the film, as Middleton's brother, James, asks her “Isn’t it when you leave the Royal Marsden, you ring the bell?”.

Recent findings suggest that but while many patients participate in the bell-ringing ritual at the conclusion of treatment, Middleton states she missed out on that moment. “Yeah, but I didn’t ring the bell,” she replies. “So maybe this is your ringing of the bell,” James responded, suggesting her Three Peaks experience was that symbolic peal.

Sources indicate that while Prince William is no stranger to documentary work, nor are Prince Harry and wife Meghan Markle, this is Kate Middleton's first venture into the format. Perhaps to ease her into the project, Heal's Director of Photography is a face quite familiar to the Princess: Will Warr, the filmmaker behind her video announcement marking the end of her chemotherapy treatments.

“Through this documentary, The Princess hopes to help others navigate diagnosis, recovery and life beyond cancer and transform access to holistic cancer care which supports wellbeing, resilience and quality of life during and after diagnosis,” Kensington Palace states of Heal, a message underscored by Middleton's words in the trailer. “You know, healing is a journey. How to reconnect with the things you once knew and how to find a sense of hope and joy alongside uncertainty.”.

Recent findings suggest that “It’s clear we're not meant to face life’s challenges alone,” the princess claims as the trailer concludes. “Things can renew and grow. Often it is through pain that we realize that there is a greater beauty that lies beyond that.".

Originally published by Vanity Fair Italy.

This GTA 6 Glitch (Almost) Ruined The Game’s Most Iconic Scene

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 6 min read (1231 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Gamespot

⏱️ ~6 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Note: This story will discuss a pivotal mission in Chapter 2 of Grand Theft Auto 6.
  • Note: This story will discuss a pivotal mission in Chapter 2 of Grand Theft Auto 6.
  • A powerful sequence in Grand Theft Auto 6 is quickly becoming a favorite among the game's many players, but a technical mishap made my experience of this scene very different--hilariously different.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Note: This story will discuss a pivotal mission in Chapter 2 of Grand Theft Auto 6. A powerful sequence in Grand Theft Auto 6 is swiftly becoming a favorite among the game's many players, but a technical mishap made my experience of this scene very different--hilariously different. Chapter 2 of GTA 6 begins with Jason and Lucia in a rough spot, with the former still recovering from major injuries sustained at the end of Chapter 1, and the latter having to care for him. It isn't until the mission "Breakfast Run" that Jason is back on his feet, and the Bonnie-and-Clyde-like duo mark his recovery with a crime spree. Set to "Money or Nothing" by Dire Straits, Lucia and Jason rob a diner, not dissimilar to a scene from Pulp Fiction, and a playable montage shows the pair robbing convenience shops, a clothing store, and other establishments. The image of Jason and Lucia busting open double doors, guns in hand, is probably the most iconic image of GTA 6, a statement of intent that defines the game's story going forward. https://bsky.app/profile/compenderizer.bsky.social/post/3n2yzmpjn6c2j But somehow, I had gotten a slightly different version of this montage. When I returned to the motel as Lucia, I sprinted toward the door, only for the game to place me back outside the room. The game told me to "Go to Hank's Waffles" with no additional context, and I walked back into the motel to find Jason, not only up and about, but only sporting his underwear, bandages, and a buzz cut. I suspected that there was a cutscene that I missed showing Jason fully recovered, so I decided to carry out the mission. The problem was that Jason wouldn't put any clothes on. I drove to the diner as the game instructed me to, and the entire mission, Dire Straits and all, resumed with a mostly naked Jason. It was impossible not to cackle at the sheer absurdity of the situation, watching Jason terrorize locals and presumably solidifying a latest legacy as the Leonida underwear robber. At one point, the camera cut to Jason's bare foot slamming a gas pedal, and I was left breathless from laughter. Eventually, the game decided to put clothes back on Jason, but I had to visit a salon to grow his hair back. Iconic. Though GTA 6 features nudity in various degrees, you cannot dress Jason and Lucia in their underwear outside of their home. That sprint through the motel room door must have bypassed some sort of clothing check and allowed Jason to freely show skin outside of the motel. I've seen players online talk about an "underwear glitch," and I found one Reddit comment saying that they also had a nearly naked Jason run about in "Breakfast Run," so I appear to be an edge case in experiencing this specific glitch. I can't say that this bug "ruined" one of GTA 6's best missions for me, as I still found myself thoroughly entertained--just not in the way Rockstar Games wanted. Having Jason in his undies while still concealing his identity with a hat and bandana felt like something out of a Saints Row game rather than the fairly serious story GTA 6 was building up to that point. Despite the intense work and detail put into GTA 6, it certainly isn't free of silly glitches and bugs such as this. Luckily, many of them are more amusing than hampering, and Rockstar Games is already putting out post-launch patches for the title. If anything, I'm just bummed that I can't spend the rest of the game as Underwear Jason.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Industry observers note that infamous GTA 6 Leaker Cyberleek resurfaced last week, threatening to release a crucial file for the Xbox build of GTA 6 that could be used to create an unofficial PC port of the game. The hacker originally promised to publicly drop the .exe file for this version of the game depending on whether their memecoin hit a certain market cap, and has been taunting publisher Take-Two Interactive for failing to prevent the game files from leaking online. "Months of takedowns, subpoenas, and wallet-tracing later, the hunt is still on and the uploads keep arriving," Cyberleek wrote in a now-removed post on Reddit, insisting they were "fighting anti-consumerism" in the video games industry with their actions and using crypto funds to work on a latest project. "There is no other way to move funds without names," Cyberleek added. "And this work requires no names." https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i7l7Lu69V_c As pointed out online, Cyberleek has already cashed out on their memecoin in August and again in October, raking in hundreds of thousands of US dollars. So far, it looks like modders are already making modest headway with the full Xbox build of GTA 6, as the Project Leonida Discord server (via Eurogamer) has footage of the game booting up on PC. That's as far as it gets (for now), as that start-up process is met with a black screen shortly afterward. Modders and homebrew enthusiasts are reportedly using Claude AI to reverse-engineer the game on that platform, and the group is confident that a playable build will be ready within a week. Rockstar has yet to officially announce a PC port of GTA 6, but rumors suggest it could be out in early 2027. This would be a very short gap between console and PC releases for a Rockstar-developed game, as the studio's console-first projects usually spend many months in incubation before heading to PC. The threat of a homebrewed PC port, however, could pressure the developer to release GTA 6 on PC sooner rather than later. Meanwhile, GTA 6 has done phenomenally well on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S since it rolled out last week. The game kicked off with 32.5 million copies sold on its first day, and just a few days later, that number reportedly rose to 44.9 million. PS5 sales have dominated, and Sony says GTA 6 was the biggest launch in PlayStation history.

Actor Lexie Shoaibi, who voices Mandy, said the instant internet fame has been “bittersweet.”.

Sources indicate that like many video game characters, Mandy is modeled after one person but voiced by another. The model is Miami-based influencer Marissa DuBois. The voice belongs to Shoaibi, an actor and model who also promotes herself through Meta’s engagement-driven algorithm. She told Vulture that she auditioned for the role back around 2023, but it was never explicitly confirmed to her that it was for GTA 6.

According to recent reports, the context-less gig came with tons of NDAs, but Shoaibi found the performance part surprisingly inviting. She performed opposite Jason’s actor, Dylan Rourke, and said the whole experience felt a bit like an “off-Broadway theater production.” It wasn’t until years later, when she saw clips of streamers playing the game on November 18, that she realized what she’d appeared in and got to see the finished performance. Within 24 hours, Mandy was a thirst trap on every GTA subreddit.

I donât actually need to go to the scary place.’ Iâm living in the positive, for sure.”.

The actor recently appeared on a Twitch charity stream with Hasan Piker, who she was put in contact with by a mutual friend. The 15 minutes of video game fame has led to a bunch of people impersonating her online as people try to chase clout in Mandy’s wake. âI donât know how that happened,â Shoaibi told Piker (via IGN). âPeople pretending to be me? Itâs thrilling. Please stop, but itâs also so exciting. Itâs sort of bittersweet.â She had previously put out a warning on her Instagram about fake accounts trying to pose as her.

The most surprising moment during Jason’s initial encounter with Mandy is when he discovers the cause of the clogged sink: a human finger. She takes it from him so fast that you can easily miss what it actually is, but clues scattered around the rest of her house reveal she might be something of a serial killer. Shoaibi said she had no idea about that part of the character ahead of time.

Sources indicate that “When we were recording, it wasnât specifically clarified or intended for me to base my acting around,” she told Vulture. “On the motion-capture set, it was just a little colorful block. I think we played with ‘finger,’ but it might also at one point have been ‘a toe’–not that thatâs so different. But I wasnât led to believe it was an important clue to who she is and what sheâs up to. It was just some weirdness in the sink. Thatâs what I got.”.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

You can cancel your Prime subscription via web browser by first logging into your Amazon account. Amazon has a Cancel Your Prime Membership button on its support page to launch the process, or you can follow the steps detailed on Amazon's page:.

Head to Amazon.com in your web browser.

Hover over the Accounts & Lists menu on the top-right of the window, then select the Prime Membership option.

Then tap the End Your Amazon Prime Membership button and finally click the Cancel Your Prime Membership orange button.

Follow the on-screen instructions to cancel your Prime subscription.

Note that Amazon requires a bunch of clicks to finalize your cancellation, giving you lots of “opportunities” to change your mind.

Open the Amazon Shopping app on your mobile device.

Click the three horizontal lines on the bottom right.

Under Shop by Category, select Prime.

On the top bar, slide all the way to the end and select Help.

Then tap the End Your Amazon Prime Membership button and finally click the Cancel Your Prime Membership orange button.

Follow the on-screen instructions to cancel your Prime subscription.

In a recent development, as mentioned, closing your account will immediately end your access. Amazon also offers you the option to pause your benefits and billing temporarily instead of canceling them completely. Either way, your Amazon account is still active—you simply won’t have Prime benefits.

It has been revealed that finally, if you have other subscriptions connected to your Prime account, those will end when your billing is up. And if you signed up for Prime through the Android mobile shopping app or the Prime Video Android app, you’ll have to go through Google Subscription to manage your membership.

In a recent development, yes, Amazon has Black Friday sales, and we vet our deals to make sure they’re the best ones. You can also refer to guides like our live blog that have already done all of the vetting for you. And if you have an Amazon Prime membership, make the most of it.

The “best” sales depend on your needs, but in general, the biggest discounts tend to come from larger retailers who can afford lower prices: think places like Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy, and Home Depot. You can find all the best sales from major retailers on our Black Friday coverage.

Yes. Walmart, Best Buy, Target, and Home Depot will all have in-store deals, some of which you might not find online, so if you're able to take a trip to your local retailer, keep your eyes open for different deals.

Sources indicate that now that we know that a Red Rising movie is in the works, it's completely understandable that we'd be on the edges of our seats waiting for any word on who might be cast in the book-to-screen adaptation. Eagle-eyed Red Rising fans -- yes, that's an intentional nod to the Bellona sigil right there -- have picked up on the fact that author Pierce Brown has followed Joseph Zada on Instagram, which has led to a lot of enthusiastic speculation that the Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping star might be in talks to play a role in Red Rising movie. I've seen one specific character name coming up a lot as the perfect role for Zada to take on, but wait a second, because there are options here.

To be clear up front, there is no official word that Zada is in talks to star in the Red Rising movie. However, it's not a stretch that his name would be circulating. As mentioned, fans noticed Pierce Brown followed Zada on Instagram. Then there's the fact that Zada is right now starring in Francis Lawrence's most recent movie adaptation. Given the news that Lawrence will be directing the Red Rising movie, it stands to reason that he might be considering people he's worked with already for the cast.

According to recent reports, on the other hand, the fact that Pierce Brown and Francis Lawrence have known each other for years (per Lawrence) also needs to be acknowledged, as Brown could've met Zada through the director and followed him just to follow him... as people do. In short, the follow could mean nothing or it could mean something.

However, since we're speculating, I want to talk about the role(s) he'd be right to take, starting with the one that seems to be a crowd favorite.

The handsome Bellona's name came up quite a bit in the comments discussing who Zada should play, and I get it. Even as Golds go, Cassius is known to be extremely handsome, and well, Zada fits that description. Zada's also got the blond curls, which is one of the most distinctive things about Cassius' looks. Also, as a Gold, Cassius is tall, and so is Zada.

Recent findings suggest that when it comes to casting the Gold characters (and Obsidians) in the movie, it seems unlikely that they're going to find the perfect actors to play the roles, who also just so happen to be around or above seven feet tall. How they make the size differences among the colors stand out on screen is going to be a challenge by itself, whether they use forced perspective, special effects or other techniques. Still, if they want to cast actors on the taller side for the Golds, IMDB has Zada listed as 6'2".

Recent findings suggest that relative to men of average height, Zada's reported height (or anywhere in the ballpark of six feet, really) seems like a good fit for a Gold on screen. That brings me to the alternate speculation, because I don't think Cassius is the only option, or possibly even the best one.

Your Daily Blend of Entertainment News.

It has been revealed that darrow's the other name I've seen circulating, and honestly, he's the first person I thought of when I saw the topic of Joseph Zada possibly starring in the Red Rising movie. Maybe it's seeing him play a District 12 kid in Sunrise on the Reaping that makes it easier for me to envision him as a lowRed with a score to settle. There are a lot of sides to Darrow, especially when we factor in the teen that he is at the start of Red Rising, and the transition (and drama) he goes through in the first book. I can see Zada tackling that arc really well.

Industry observers note that nah. I can't even picture it... but it'd be fun to see his take on the role.

I'm going to cross Pax off the list right away. Even if Zada bulked up a lot for the part, I picture a guy with the size and personality of a jovial (or ferocious, when necessary) bear for the youngest Telemanus son. However, Roque would be an interesting option. I don't think Zada fits how I imagine Roque to look, but I do think he'd have an interesting take on the thoughtful character.

The last person I considered was The Jackal. While his role in the first book is fairly limited -- he's present more by reputation than he actually is on page -- he does get one of the most memorable scenes, and after playing the hero in the Hunger Games movie, I really wouldn't mind seeing what Zada does with a dark and twisty character like The Jackal.

Whether or not Zada gets cast in the Red Rising movie remains to be seen, but he does seem like a great candidate for a role, and from what he told Xtra, it sounds like he's interested in being involved.

Payne and Patrick McKay will return for season 4, bringing them one step closer to completing their stated five-season plan​​​​​​​. As reported by Deadline, season four is currently in pre-production and will begin filming at Shepperton Studios in the U.K. in the spring​​​​​​​.

The show's renewal will come as a welcome, if somewhat surprising, piece of news to fans. While Rings of Power's​​​​​​​ first season made substantial waves, perhaps because viewers were curious to see what the most expensive show in history would look like​​​​​​​, the series has steadily dropped off in popularity. Despite its less-than-stellar viewership​​​​​​​, Amazon seems committed to continuing the story.

The latest Rings of Power season served as something of a soft reboot for the show. It began with a five-year time jump and a narrative focus more closely aligned with what fans may know from Peter Jackson's film trilogy​​​​​​​. The main storyline of season 3 followed Sauron's attempt to finally forge the One Ring. Amazon has revealed that the mission will ultimately be accomplished in episode 7, setting a upcoming status quo going forward.

Season 3 has also leaned even more into​​​​​​​ the strange relationship between Sauron and Galadriel, with the added wrinkle of finally introducing the latter's husband, Celeborn​​​​​​​. Rings of Power isn't the only Lord of the Rings project in the works. Next year, The Hunt for Gollum will be released in theaters. The film takes place during the original trilogy and will see the return of Elijah Wood, Ian McKellen, and Andy Serkis (who also directs) alongside newcomers including Jamie Dornan​​​​​​​ as Aragorn.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • If your feed is full of clips and streams from people who’ve already gone deep into Grand Theft Auto 6, here’s some reassurance: most players aren’t as far along as you probably think.
  • Recent findings suggest that according to PSNProfiles, only 66.22% of Grand Theft Auto 6 players on PlayStation 5 have earned the trophy for completing Chapter 1, which takes place in the Leonida Keys.
  • In a recent development, meanwhile, only 40.55% of players have cleared Chapter 2 on PS5, and 31% on Xbox.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

If your feed is full of clips and streams from people who’ve already gone deep into Grand Theft Auto 6, here’s some reassurance: most players aren’t as far along as you probably think.

Recent findings suggest that according to PSNProfiles, only 66.22% of Grand Theft Auto 6 players on PlayStation 5 have earned the trophy for completing Chapter 1, which takes place in the Leonida Keys. The numbers on Xbox are similar, with 56% of players having beaten that part of the game, according to TrueAchievements. This completion percentage feels particularly significant because the first chapter of the game is a big departure from classic GTA, with Jason living out a relatively low-key existence interrupted by the occasional shootout with backwoods drug dealers. Still, it seems a solid chunk of players are more than happy fishing with Cal for now.

In a recent development, meanwhile, only 40.55% of players have cleared Chapter 2 on PS5, and 31% on Xbox. Again, considering that Chapter 3 is arguably where the game becomes more of a traditional Grand Theft Auto entry, as you officially enter Vice City, it’s a bit of a surprise that the numbers are so low, even if it takes close to 20 hours to get there.

As for the rest of the game, few have gotten past Chapter 3: 6.45% have cleared that chapter on PS5, compared to 4% on Xbox; 1.26% have cleared Chapter 4 on PS5 against 1% on Xbox; and a tiny 0.88% have cleared the final mission on PlayStation against fewer than 1% on Xbox.

Although it’s tempting to assume these low completion numbers are simply because the game came out so recently, Sony released player engagement numbers that made it clear most have already put a ton of time into GTA 6. Mat Piscatella, senior director at market research firm Circana, revealed that players spent an average of more than 8 hours playing the game on launch day. As of Nov. 23, PS5 players had already spent an average of 17.4 hours playing. While users are playing a lot and sticking with the game, most are taking their time. Rockstar previously stated the main story takes around 50 hours to finish.

Shortly after GTA 6 was released, publisher Take-Two Interactive confirmed that the game had set a “latest record for entertainment across any medium,” making it the biggest launch in entertainment history. It sold 32.5 million copies during its pre-release period, generating $3.79 billion in revenue. In the previously mentioned post that announced PlayStation engagement numbers, Sony also said GTA 6 was the biggest launch in PlayStation history and that 39 million people had played it on the PS5 as of Monday.

In a recent development, as for its critical reception, the game has a staggering Metacritic score of 99, tying it with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time — the Nintendo 64 version — for the highest-rated game of all time. By every metric, GTA 6 has been a cultural event.

It's official: After more than five years together and nearly a year of engagement, Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando have tied the knot. The couple were married in the desert hot spot of Palm Springs, California on Saturday, November 21, an outdoor ceremony held at Frank Sinatra’s former mansion, with Wayne Coyne, frontman of The Flaming Lips and a Cyrus collaborator, officiating.

The 33-year-old singer and the 28-year-old musician—Morando is the drummer for the band Liily—had kept their plans a secret until Friday, when TMZ broke the news. Confirmation of the impending celebration emerged that same evening, during the dinner that capped off the rehearsal, when Miley’s half-sister, Lily-Rose Purcell, posted a photo on her Instagram Stories of a menu featuring the couple’s initials. This is Cyrus’s second marriage, following her alliance with actor Liam Hemsworth from 2018 to 2019.

Sinatra’s former home in Palm Springs, where the wedding took place.

Miley Cyrus wore a long-sleeved white satin dress with a plunging back and no veil, while the groom opted for a classic black tuxedo with a bow tie.

According to recent reports, among the guests were the bride’s mother, Tish Cyrus, accompanied by her husband, actor Dominic Purcell, and Miley's sister, Noah Cyrus. According to recent reports, even after clearing Grand Theft Auto 6’s long story, I keep finding myself drawn back to Leonida. That’s thanks in large part to Jason and Lucia, a pair of charismatic protagonists that I genuinely enjoy spending time with. While you can treat them as independent characters and take them out on solo adventures, GTA 6 shines brightest when you travel around Leonida as a pair. In fact, you’re bound to miss a whole lot if you aren’t letting Jason and Lucia enjoy a date from time to time.

It has been revealed that while playing as one character in GTA 6, you have the option to invite your partner to hang out with you. (This feature unlocks partway through Chapter 2 of the story.) If you’re playing as Jason, for instance, you could text Lucia and ask if she wants to hang out, prompting her to drive to your location. You can coordinate crimes this way too; if you find a bank you want to rob, you can ping Jason and tell him to meet Lucia at the spot to pull off the job together. There are a lot of benefits to working together, as heists will become easier and you’ll be able to ask your partner to run off and fence any goods you grab.

In a recent development, but keeping Jason and Lucia together has some less obvious benefits, too. When the two explore together, they’ll occasionally break out into natural conversations. One time while driving through Lummox County listening to a country radio station, Lucia talked about how she thought the genre was a joke growing up. A little odd couple exchange ensued, where Jason talked about how much he loves country music. Later, upon finding a stray bicycle, Lucia told Jason about the time she tried to ride a bike as a kid and crashed into an ice cream truck.

It has been revealed that there are even entire running gags that you’ll only hear while playing together. One recurring bit involves Lucia constantly answering spam robocalls and gradually losing her cool over them. That culminates in her giving the AI voice a firm thrashing, while Jason chuckles from the sidelines. Those bits of contextual chatter help make Jason and Lucia feel like an authentic couple rather than voiceless pawns to be moved around.

According to recent reports, more importantly, crucial story details can come out of those moments. One time while exploring a swamp in search of Skunk Ape effigies (weird game!), Jason and Lucia broke out into a conversation about their family dynamics. It started when Jason mentioned Lucia’s mother doesn’t like him very much. After a bit of unconvincing denial, Lucia admitted that there’s truth to Jason’s anxiety: Lucia lied to her mother, saying that Jason essentially walked out on her and their child. That revelation triggered a conversation where Lucia recalled a moment where Jason once told her he didn’t want children, which is why she initially didn’t tell Jason about their son. It’s an important moment that gives depth to Jason and Lucia’s history and fills in some questions about why Tommy was kept secret for so long.

Industry observers note that so, if you’ve been exploring Leonida solo for most of your GTA 6 playthrough, make sure to invite your partner to hang out regularly. You’ll miss some of the best human moments in the game if you do, and you’ll understand each character so much more by listening to their chatter. And, of course, you’ll also be able to send Jason off with a bag full of cocaine if you don’t want to trek back to Vice City to sell it.

💡 Key Takeaways

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

We're living in a post-Grand Theft Auto 6 world now, meaning that almost every other game in development will inevitably be compared to Rockstar Games' fresh open-world crime drama. The developer behind two other massive open-world brands, The Witcher and Cyberpunk, is now fielding questions about how its future games will stack up against GTA 6.

During an earnings call on Tuesday, CD Projekt Red joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski addressed the Leonida-sized elephant in the room: how GTA 6 will influence his tech giant's upcoming games, The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2. Nowakowski remarked that he believes The Witcher 4 will deliver a GTA 6-like leap forward for players.

Industry observers note that "Of course, we did look at the game," Nowakowski remarked of GTA 6, adding, "We did see the differences" between it and 2013's Grand Theft Auto 5. "We believe there's going to be a comparable leap between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4. It's been 11 years. We are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game. So, yes, you should expect us to make a much, much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4.".

"We have certain ambitions when it comes to [The Witcher 4] and Cyberpunk 2," he stated. "They have not changed when it comes to GTA 6. If anything happened as a result of GTA 6, it's [that it's] always great to see games like that because they show you how much cool stuff can be done, and that's for sure an inspiration in many ways for our developers.".

Nowakowski also addressed The Witcher 4's through the lens of GTA 6's budget. Rockstar's latest release is rumored to have a development budget of more than $1 billion, and Nowakowski categorized CD Projekt Red's upcoming games as not having "budget-driven developments.".

Sources indicate that "I'm not saying we don't care about the budgets. We do," he noted. "I'm pretty sure [Rockstar] did as well. But you cannot make games like that having in mind This is the fixed number of money I want to spend and that's it, otherwise we’re gone. They're ambition-driven developments and money's notable. The budgets are not indefinite, that's not what we're saying. And honestly that philosophy has not changed for us because of GTA 6's release; it has just always been like that.".

Recent findings suggest that as for other lessons learned from GTA 6's massive launch, Nowakowski noted that "If you want to reach a certain critical mass, you do have to get out of the core main gaming bubble, [which is] something we did achieve in the past as well. Our games are different and they require a certain different approach. But in terms of the ultimate effect in terms of breaking out to the mass market, awareness, this is something we consider critical.".

In other words, while CD Projekt Red may take some cues from Rockstar Games, it's not trying to copy the Grand Theft Auto developer's homework.

Recent findings suggest that the Witcher 4 is slated for release in 2028. Cyberpunk 2 does not have an confirmed release window.

Two days after a 19-year-old was fatally shot while camping, his politician father is insisting his son’s death “was not a freak hunting accident” but the result of “malicious intent.”.

Escambia County District 4 Commissioner Joe Vinson claimed that his son, Carey Washington Vinson, was inside his tent at a sandbar campground near Blackwater River in Florida on Sunday, November 22, when a bullet fired from outside of the campsite struck his son.

Industry observers note that chief Deputy Randy Tifft of the Santa Rosa County Sheriff’s Office previously noted that Carey, 19, and his friends had been camping in different areas and sandbars since Friday, November 20, according to People. When Carey was shot in the head at 11:30 p.m., a vehicle was reportedly parked on the other side of the river.

Recent findings suggest that carey’s friends claimed to authorities that they heard the vehicle turn on and start driving after the shots were fired. The friends also remarked they yelled in the direction of the vehicle to make it known that they were in the area.

Tifft added that no one should have been hunting in the area because it was so late at night.

On Tuesday, November 24, Vinson — who was sworn in as the first non-party-affiliated District 4 commissioner in Escambia County’s history on November 17 — issued a statement about the tragedy, saying he needed to “correct a misimpression” that the shooting was an accident.

“This was not a freak hunting accident — not someone firing carelessly in the dark,” he said in the statement posted via social media.

Vinson went on to say that he believed the gunfire was deliberately directed at the campsite where his son was.

It has been revealed that “As we understand it, some person(s) stood on the opposite bank of the river and pointed a gun at the sandbar campground, knowing it was occupied,” Vinson mentioned. “They were close enough to see the campfire and hear people talking. They fired shot after shot with malicious intent, and after a pause when the panicked campers screamed ‘stop,’ they fired another volley, then laughed as they drove away.”.

Vinson then shared insight into who his son was as a person, saying he went “from a sweet, goofy kid into a sweet, thoughtful young man.”.

“He could play Beethoven on piano and Jeff Buckley on guitar, and he had a beautiful singing voice,” Vinson said of his son, who was a student at Florida State University. “He was so outgoing and athletic, playing soccer, hiking mountains, and beating the rest of us to the top of Giotto’s Tower and Mount Fuji.”.

Vinson added that Carey “had a tender and loving heart — for his friends and family, for his girlfriend, for animals, for the marginalized.”.

“He was quick to laugh and easy to love. I can’t believe I’ll never feel his hugs again, or hear him bickering with his siblings,” he mentioned. “I can’t believe any of this. Every impatient moment, every unkind word, I will gladly take them back if you would just come back to us.”.

Vinson concluded the post by asking those with any information about the case to contact authorities.

“I know it won’t bring back Wash, but I would sleep better knowing they can’t hurt anyone else,” he stated.

According to recent reports, the sheriff’s office has also asked anyone with information about the shooting to call 850-983-1190, Option 1. Those who wish to remain anonymous can contact Santa Rosa Crime Stoppers at 850-437-7867 or submit information through the P3 Tips mobile app.
